LISTING_STATUS  
Indicates the current availability state of the rental listing in the RENTAL_INFORMATION table (e.g., ACTIVE, PENDING, RENTED, INACTIVE, or CANCELLED). This column is used to track and manage the lifecycle of each rental listing.
